description: This file implements an HTTP server using the libsoup library. It handles incoming HTTP requests, parses JSON payloads, processes GET and POST methods related to a specific data model, and sends JSON responses. It also manages the lifecycle of the server, including starting and stopping the server, and logs performance metrics and errors.

methods.name: void HttpServerStop()
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server and disconnects the server instance.
